tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search issues across the user's repositories by text, state or label. Returns up to 50 matches, newest first.

query.description: Words to look for in titles and bodies.

label.description: Only issues with this label, e.g. bug.

tools.name: manage_issue
tools.description: Create, read, update or close one issue. Use operation to choose what to do; closing needs the issue number.

operation.description: What to do with the issue.

number.description: The issue number, for read, update and close.

title.description: The title, for create and update.

body.description: The text in Markdown, for create and update.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Permanently delete one comment on an issue. Ask the user first: this cannot be undone.

comment_id.description: The id of the comment, from search_issues or manage_issue.
